messages:
natalie: Heads-up — ACME reported sudden throttling on their Dedicated pool right after a plan migration. Customers seeing steady 429/503 for short bursts. Ticket #9876. Repro attached (curl).

mike: Can you paste tenant_id and the exact curl you used?

natalie: tenant_id: tenant-acme-42
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"healthcheck"}'

ops-bot: ALERT: pool-dedicated-us-east — tenant-acme-42 hit per-tenant rate cap (effective limit=1 rps) at 2026-03-15T14:02:12Z

eva: Note: autoscaler scaled pool-dedicated-us-east down to 1 node at ~14:00, burst capacity was reduced. That will lower concurrent token throughput.

mike: Quick dig: config-service shows tenant config persisted as `quota_units: 6000` during the migration but our parser expects `units_per_minute`. Fallback path sets limit to 1 rps when it can't find the canonical key — looks like a regression from the migration code.

jordan: Summary: plan-change flow wrote legacy key `quota_units` -> config-service didn't normalize -> runtime used fallback 1rps. Confirmed.

natalie: Customer-facing note: this matches their observation (1 RPS). They need immediate relief. Can we hotfix and manually bump their quota?

mike: I'll cut a canary for config-service with a normalization patch (normalize legacy keys -> units_per_minute). Pushing rev r332 now, will run smoke tests against infra-qa. ETA ~20m.

eva: For immediate relief I can apply a tenant override via the admin API. Example payload:

POST /admin/tenants/tenant-acme-42/override
Content-Type: application/json

{"units_per_minute":6000}

I'll only do this after we see the canary healthy.

ops-bot: DEPLOY: config-service r332 -> canary started (infra-qa). Monitoring: /metrics/quota_parse_errors, /metrics/tenant_quota_overrides.

natalie: :thumbsup: I'll notify CS and mark ticket 9876 "mitigated (temporary override)" once override applied. Please drop a note here when the canary is healthy.

support-bot: Ticket 9876 updated: temporary override queued, awaiting canary success. Labels added: [dedicated, quota-parse-regression, high-priority].
